figurative_meaning_bn: অতিপাতক, উপপাতক ও মহাপাতক- এই তিনপ্রকার পাপ
figurative_meaning_en: The three types of sins: minor sin (atipātak), medium sin (upapātak), and major sin (mahāpātak)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনযাপন ত্রিপাপের মতো পাপময় হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His lifestyle has become as sinful as the three sins.
The scriptures describe the three sins in detail.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu scriptural classifications of sins.
